# Data statistics

```{r load_metadata, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
rawdata_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_rawdata.tsv"))
datasets <- rawdata_metadata$rawdata_id
sample_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_sample.tsv"))
capture_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_capture.tsv"))
specimen_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_specimen.tsv"))
sampling_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_sampling.tsv"))
host_metadata <- read_tsv(file=str_c("data/",release,"_host.tsv"))

composition_metadata <- rawdata_metadata %>%
  filter(preprocessing_required)
```

## Amount of data

### Absolute total data

```{r rawdata_absolute, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
rawdata_metadata %>%
  summarise(
    release_hologenomes=n(),
    genomic_only=sum(!preprocessing_required),
    metagenomic=sum(preprocessing_required)
  ) %>%
  tt()

composition_metadata %>%
  summarise(
    total=sum(total_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    host=sum(host_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    metagenomic=sum(metagenomic_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    lowqual=sum(lowqual_gb, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tt()
```

### Relative total data

```{r rawdata_relative, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
composition_metadata %>%
  summarise(total=sum(total_gb, na.rm=TRUE),host=sum(host_gb, na.rm=TRUE),metagenomic=sum(metagenomic_gb, na.rm=TRUE),lowqual=sum(lowqual_gb, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(host=host/total*100,metagenomic=metagenomic/total*100,lowqual=lowqual/total*100) %>% 
  mutate(total=total/total*100) %>% 
  tt()
```

### Per-sample data

```{r rawdata_absolute_persample, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
composition_metadata %>%
  summarise(
    available=sum(!is.na(total_gb)),
    total=mean(total_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    total_sd=sd(total_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    host=mean(host_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    metagenomic=mean(metagenomic_gb, na.rm=TRUE),
    lowqual=mean(lowqual_gb, na.rm=TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tt()
```

### Per-sample relative data

```{r rawdata_absolute_persample_relative, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
composition_metadata %>%
  mutate(host_rel=host_gb/total_gb*100,
         metagenomic_rel=metagenomic_gb/total_gb*100,
         lowqual_rel=lowqual_gb/total_gb*100) %>%
  filter(host_rel>=0 & metagenomic_rel>=0, lowqual_rel>=0) %>% 
  summarise(host_mean=mean(host_rel),
            host_sd=sd(host_rel),
            metagenomic_mean=mean(metagenomic_rel),
            metagenomic_sd=sd(metagenomic_rel),
            lowqual_mean=mean(lowqual_rel),
            lowqual_sd=sd(lowqual_rel)) %>%
  tt()
```

## Amount of samples

```{r host_species_summary, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
summary_table <- sampling_metadata %>% 
  separate_rows(capture_id, sep = ", ") %>%
  right_join(capture_metadata,by="capture_id") %>%
  select(-capture_id) %>%
  right_join(specimen_metadata,by="specimen_id") %>%
  inner_join(host_metadata,by="host_species") %>%
  select(-capture_id) %>%
  separate_rows(sample_id, sep = ", ") %>%
  right_join(sample_metadata,by="sample_id") %>%
  select(-rawdata_id) %>%
  right_join(rawdata_metadata,by="sample_id") %>%
  separate_rows(rawdata_id, sep = ", ") %>%
  filter(rawdata_id %in% datasets)

summary_table %>% 
  group_by(host_species,host_order,host_class) %>% 
  summarise(events=n_distinct(sampling_id),individuals=n_distinct(specimen_id),samples=n_distinct(sample_id),data=sum(total_gb, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  tt()
```

## Sample type statistics
```{r sample_type_summary, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
summary_table %>% 
  mutate(sample_type=ifelse(sample_type=="Skin swab: dorsal","Skin swab",sample_type),
         sample_type=ifelse(sample_type=="Skin swab: ventral","Skin swab",sample_type)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_type) %>% 
  summarise(samples=n()) %>% 
  tt()
```

## Country statistics

```{r number_countries, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
sampling_metadata %>%
  pull(country) %>%
  unique() %>% 
  length()

country_summary <- summary_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(country), country != "") %>%
  count(country, name="samples") %>%
  mutate(
    # Natural Earth uses this name for the USA.
    map_country=recode(country, "USA"="United States of America")
  )

country_summary %>%
  select(country, samples) %>%
  tt()
```

### Geographic distribution

The countries represented in the second data release are shaded by their
number of samples. Labels are placed automatically and can be adjusted in the
vector files written to the `figure` directory.

```{r world-map, fig.cap="Geographic distribution of samples in the second EHI data release. Country colour and labels show the number of samples.", fig.width=13, fig.height=6.5, out.width="100%", dpi=300, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
world_map <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  scale="small",
  returnclass="sf"
) %>%
  filter(admin != "Antarctica")

unmatched_countries <- country_summary %>%
  anti_join(
    world_map %>%
      sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
      distinct(admin),
    by=c("map_country"="admin")
  )

if (nrow(unmatched_countries) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Countries missing from the map: ",
    paste(unmatched_countries$country, collapse=", ")
  )
}

map_crs <- "ESRI:54030" # Robinson projection

world_map <- world_map %>%
  left_join(country_summary, by=c("admin"="map_country")) %>%
  sf::st_transform(map_crs)

country_labels <- world_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(samples)) %>%
  sf::st_point_on_surface()

label_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(country_labels)

country_labels <- country_labels %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    x=label_coordinates[, "X"],
    y=label_coordinates[, "Y"],
    label=str_c(country, "\nn = ", format(samples, big.mark=",", trim=TRUE)),
    label_colour=if_else(
      country %in% c("USA", "Australia"),
      "#FFFFFF",
      "#111111"
    )
  )

world_map_plot <- ggplot(world_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill=samples),
    colour="#A9AFB3",
    linewidth=0.18
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name="Number of\nsamples",
    low="#FDE7A0",
    high="#17386D",
    na.value="#EEF0F2",
    limits=c(0, max(country_summary$samples)),
    breaks=pretty(c(0, max(country_summary$samples)), n=5)
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data=country_labels,
    aes(x=x, y=y, label=label, colour=label_colour),
    seed=2025,
    size=3.0,
    lineheight=0.9,
    segment.colour="#333333",
    segment.size=0.3,
    min.segment.length=0,
    box.padding=0.35,
    point.padding=0.15,
    max.overlaps=Inf,
    max.time=5,
    show.legend=FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  coord_sf(datum=NA, expand=FALSE, clip="off") +
  guides(
    fill=guide_colourbar(
      barheight=grid::unit(35, "mm"),
      barwidth=grid::unit(4, "mm"),
      ticks.colour="#333333",
      frame.colour="#333333"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size=11) +
  theme(
    legend.position="right",
    legend.title=element_text(size=10),
    legend.text=element_text(size=9),
    plot.margin=margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_world_map.svg")),
  plot=world_map_plot,
  width=13,
  height=6.5,
  units="in",
  device=svglite::svglite
)

ggsave(
  filename=file.path("figure", str_c(release, "_world_map.pdf")),
  plot=world_map_plot,
  width=13,
  height=6.5,
  units="in",
  device=grDevices::cairo_pdf
)

world_map_plot
```


## Environmental representation

```{r number_environments, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
sampling_metadata %>%
  group_by(biome) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  arrange(-count) %>% 
  tt()
```
